description: Named cases for the rar-model containment semantics: every rule, every malformed shape, the size limits and the models document. Run by RarModelVectorsTest through Vectors.run; the wave-2 runners (the authenticator, the issuer, the refresh path) read the same file through Vectors.load. Expectations compare canonical JSON, so member order and number spelling do not matter. The pinned fingerprints change only when a built-in model changes, deliberately.
